name: Shadow

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.effect: Target's physical attack rolls have -1 for the rest of the encounter (stacks). A creature reduced to 0 by this effect dies and spawns a new Shadow in 1d4 hours.

actions.name: Shadow Lurk
actions.effect: The Shadow hides in dim light or darkness, becoming invisible until it attacks or is exposed to bright light.

reactions.name: Shadow Slip
reactions.effect: When hit by a non-radiant attack, the Shadow can reduce the damage by half by letting the blow pass through its shadowy form.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Can move through creatures and objects. Takes 2d6 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: In dim light or darkness, the Shadow is virtually invisible and has +2d6 to stealth.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: In sunlight, the Shadow has -1d6 to attack rolls and all defenses are reduced by 2.

lore: Shadows are undead creatures born from the darkness left behind when a soul is torn from its body. They lurk in unlit corners and dark passages, draining the strength from the living to spawn more of their kind.
